headline: Kano targets $700m sesame, hibiscus exports by 2027
summary: Kano State exported sesame seeds and hibiscus flowers worth more than $350 million in 2025, according to a Nigerian Export Promotion Council official. The state aims for $700 million in such exports by 2027.
why: Agricultural commodity exports such as sesame and hibiscus are a source of foreign currency for Nigerian states and feed global food and beverage supply chains.
